description: Render an upstream DataFrame to a PDF report (reportlab table mode or Jinja2/weasyprint HTML mode). Drop-in for Alteryx Render / Portfolio Composer.

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

file_path.label: File Path
file_path.description: Output PDF path (local or fsspec URL: s3://, gs://, abfs://)

title.description: Report title shown at the top of the first page
title.label: Title

template.description: Rendering mode: 'table' (DataFrame as a tabular PDF via reportlab) or 'template_html' (render a Jinja2 HTML template + convert via weasyprint). When template_html, set `html_template` to a path / inline string.
template.label: Template Mode

html_template.label: HTML Template
html_template.description: File path or inline Jinja2 string (required for template=template_html)

rows_per_page.description: For template='table': max rows per page (chunked into multiple Table flowables).
rows_per_page.label: Rows Per Page

columns.description: Subset of columns to include. None = all columns.
columns.label: Columns

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current date partition (time partitions).
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current static/dynamic partition key.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.
